New in this build:
- MIDI out into your DAW from the plug-in (Logic Pro: make a Software Instrument track, set its MIDI input to BreakBoss in the track settings, arm it and record).
- SELECT tool: drag the right edge of selected notes to make them longer or shorter.
- Channel rack: the play button is now IMPORT, which opens BreakBoss's sound library (every sound sorted by type and pack, plus importing single sounds or whole packs).
- FOLLOW DAW: BreakBoss's play and stop buttons now work while the DAW is running.
- Artist-style kits and presets, genre kits section, Snap to Scale button in the drum roll.

Please try recording BreakBoss MIDI into your DAW, trimming notes, loading sounds from the library, and the transport buttons with the DAW playing.
